1: ---
     2: # Configure Splunk input (S2S) certificate from operator-mounted TLS secret.
     3: # Input: /mnt/tls/splunk-input-tls-cert/{tls.crt, tls.key[, ca.crt]}
     4: # Output: bundled PEM at /opt/splunk/etc/auth/input-bundle.pem
     5: #         CA at /opt/splunk/etc/auth/splunk-input-ca.pem
     6: #         inputs.conf [SSL] configured
     7: 
     8: - name: Generate ephemeral SSL passphrase for input cert
     9:   command: >
    10:     python3 -c
    11:     "import secrets, base64; print(base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(40)).decode())"
    12:   register: input_ssl_passphrase
    13:   changed_when: false
    14:   no_log: true
    15: 
    16: - name: Ensure Splunk auth directory exists
    17:   file:
    18:     path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth"
    19:     state: directory
    20:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    21:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
    22:     mode: '0700'
    23:   become: yes
    24:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    25: 
    26: - name: Write input cert bundle script
    27:   copy:
    28:     dest: /tmp/splunk_bundle_input_cert.py
    29:     content: |
    30:       from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import (
    31:           load_pem_private_key, Encoding, PrivateFormat, BestAvailableEncryption
    32:       )
    33:       import sys
    34: 
    35:       passphrase = sys.argv[1].encode()
    36:       key_path   = '/mnt/tls/splunk-input-tls-cert/tls.key'
    37:       cert_path  = '/mnt/tls/splunk-input-tls-cert/tls.crt'
    38:       out_path   = sys.argv[2] + '/etc/auth/input-bundle.pem'
    39: 
    40:       with open(key_path, 'rb') as f:
    41:           key = load_pem_private_key(f.read(), password=None)
    42: 
    43:       enc_key_pem = key.private_bytes(
    44:           Encoding.PEM,
    45:           PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
    46:           BestAvailableEncryption(passphrase)
    47:       )
    48: 
    49:       with open(cert_path, 'rb') as f:
    50:           cert_pem = f.read()
    51: 
    52:       with open(out_path, 'wb') as f:
    53:           f.write(cert_pem)
    54:           if not cert_pem.endswith(b'\n'):
    55:               f.write(b'\n')
    56:           f.write(enc_key_pem)
    57:     mode: '0700'
    58: 
    59: - name: Encrypt private key and build input cert bundle
    60:   command: >
    61:     python3 /tmp/splunk_bundle_input_cert.py
    62:     {{ input_ssl_passphrase.stdout }} {{ splunk.home }}
    63:   become: yes
    64:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    65:   no_log: true
    66: 
    67: - name: Set input bundle permissions
    68:   file:
    69:     path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/input-bundle.pem"
    70:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    71:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
    72:     mode: '0600'
    73:   become: yes
    74:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
    75: 
    76: - name: Check if ca.crt is present in input cert mount
    77:   stat:
    78:     path: /mnt/tls/splunk-input-tls-cert/ca.crt
    79:   register: input_ca_file
    80: 
    81: - name: Set sslRootCAPath to system bundle when ca.crt is absent
    82:   set_fact:
    83:     input_ca_path: /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem
    84:   when: not input_ca_file.stat.exists
    85: 
    86: - name: Write CA trust bundle script
    87:   copy:
    88:     dest: /tmp/splunk_build_input_ca_bundle.py
    89:     content: |
    90:       # tls.crt from the operator-mounted secret may contain intermediate
    91:       # certs that are not repeated in ca.crt (e.g. Vault PKI issuers put
    92:       # only the root in ca.crt). Splunk requires the full chain to be
    93:       # present locally in sslRootCAPath -- it does not complete the chain
    94:       # using intermediates presented by the peer during the handshake.
    95:       # Assemble tls.crt's non-leaf certs + ca.crt into one deduplicated
    96:       # trust bundle.
    97:       import sys
    98: 
    99:       tls_crt_path = '/mnt/tls/splunk-input-tls-cert/tls.crt'
   100:       ca_crt_path = '/mnt/tls/splunk-input-tls-cert/ca.crt'
   101:       out_path = sys.argv[1] + '/etc/auth/splunk-input-ca.pem'
   102: 
   103:       def split_pem_certs(data):
   104:           certs = []
   105:           current = []
   106:           for line in data.splitlines(keepends=True):
   107:               if line.strip() == b'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----':
   108:                   current = [line]
   109:               elif line.strip() == b'-----END CERTIFICATE-----':
   110:                   current.append(line)
   111:                   certs.append(b''.join(current))
   112:                   current = []
   113:               elif current:
   114:                   current.append(line)
   115:           return certs
   116: 
   117:       with open(tls_crt_path, 'rb') as f:
   118:           tls_certs = split_pem_certs(f.read())
   119:       chain_certs = tls_certs[1:]  # drop the leaf; keep any presented intermediates/root
   120: 
   121:       with open(ca_crt_path, 'rb') as f:
   122:           ca_certs = split_pem_certs(f.read())
   123: 
   124:       seen = set()
   125:       ordered = []
   126:       for cert in chain_certs + ca_certs:
   127:           if cert not in seen:
   128:               seen.add(cert)
   129:               ordered.append(cert)
   130: 
   131:       with open(out_path, 'wb') as f:
   132:           for cert in ordered:
   133:               f.write(cert)
   134:               if not cert.endswith(b'\n'):
   135:                   f.write(b'\n')
   136:     mode: '0700'
   137:   when: input_ca_file.stat.exists
   138: 
   139: - name: Build input CA trust bundle
   140:   command: >
   141:     python3 /tmp/splunk_build_input_ca_bundle.py
   142:     {{ splunk.home }}
   143:   become: yes
   144:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   145:   changed_when: true
   146:   when: input_ca_file.stat.exists
   147: 
   148: - name: Set CA trust bundle permissions
   149:   file:
   150:     path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/splunk-input-ca.pem"
   151:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   152:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   153:     mode: '0644'
   154:   become: yes
   155:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   156:   when: input_ca_file.stat.exists
   157: 
   158: - name: Set sslRootCAPath to the assembled CA trust bundle
   159:   set_fact:
   160:     input_ca_path: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/splunk-input-ca.pem"
   161:   when: input_ca_file.stat.exists
   162: 
   163: - name: Configure serverCert in inputs.conf [SSL]
   164:   ini_file:
   165:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/inputs.conf"
   166:     section: SSL
   167:     option: serverCert
   168:     value: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/auth/input-bundle.pem"
   169:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   170:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   171:   become: yes
   172:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   173: 
   174: - name: Configure sslPassword in inputs.conf [SSL]
   175:   ini_file:
   176:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/inputs.conf"
   177:     section: SSL
   178:     option: sslPassword
   179:     value: "{{ input_ssl_passphrase.stdout }}"
   180:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   181:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   182:   become: yes
   183:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   184:   no_log: true
   185:   changed_when: false
   186: 
   187: - name: Configure sslRootCAPath in inputs.conf [SSL]
   188:   ini_file:
   189:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/inputs.conf"
   190:     section: SSL
   191:     option: sslRootCAPath
   192:     value: "{{ input_ca_path }}"
   193:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   194:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   195:   become: yes
   196:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   197: 
   198: # enable_s2s.yml (legacy S2S flow) may have already written the deprecated
   199: # rootCA key to this same [SSL] stanza, pointing at $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/auth/cacert.pem
   200: # regardless of the operator-mounted cert. Overwrite it here so the two SSL
   201: # trust settings in inputs.conf agree.
   202: - name: Configure rootCA in inputs.conf [SSL] to match sslRootCAPath
   203:   ini_file:
   204:     dest: "{{ splunk.home }}/etc/system/local/inputs.conf"
   205:     section: SSL
   206:     option: rootCA
   207:     value: "{{ input_ca_path }}"
   208:     owner: "{{ splunk.user }}"
   209:     group: "{{ splunk.group }}"
   210:   become: yes
   211:   become_user: "{{ splunk.user }}"

    40: - name: Register the AWS plugin (pinned to the staged binary's sha256)
    41:   ansible.builtin.command:
    42:     cmd: >-
    43:       bao plugin register
    44:       -sha256={{ openbao_aws_plugin_stat.stat.checksum }}
    45:       -command={{ openbao_aws_plugin_command }}
    46:       -version={{ openbao_aws_plugin_catalog_version }}
    47:       secret {{ openbao_aws_plugin_name }}
    48:   environment:
    49:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
    50:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
    51:   no_log: true
    52:   register: openbao_aws_plugin_register
    53:   changed_when: true
    54:   when:
    55:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
    56:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
    57:     - (openbao_aws_plugin_check.rc | default(1)) != 0
    58: 
    59: - name: Enable the AWS secrets engine
    60:   ansible.builtin.command:
    61:     cmd: >-
    62:       bao secrets enable -path={{ openbao_aws_mount }}
    63:       -plugin-version={{ openbao_aws_plugin_catalog_version }}
    64:       {{ openbao_aws_plugin_name }}
    65:   environment:
    66:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
    67:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
    68:   no_log: true
    69:   changed_when: true
    70:   when:
    71:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
    72:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
    73:     - (openbao_aws_mount ~ '/') not in (openbao_mounts_raw.stdout | from_json).keys()
    74: 
    75: - name: Tune the existing AWS mount to the declared plugin version
    76:   ansible.builtin.command:
    77:     cmd: >-
    78:       bao secrets tune -plugin-version={{ openbao_aws_plugin_catalog_version }}
    79:       {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/
    80:   environment:
    81:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
    82:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
    83:   no_log: true
    84:   register: openbao_aws_plugin_tune
    85:   changed_when: true
    86:   when:
    87:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
    88:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
    89:     - (openbao_aws_mount ~ '/') in (openbao_mounts_raw.stdout | from_json).keys()
    90:     - >-
    91:       ((openbao_mounts_raw.stdout | from_json)[openbao_aws_mount ~ '/'].plugin_version
    92:        | default('')) != openbao_aws_plugin_catalog_version
    93: 
    94: - name: Reload the AWS plugin across the Raft cluster after an upgrade
    95:   ansible.builtin.command:
    96:     cmd: "bao plugin reload -plugin={{ openbao_aws_plugin_name }} -scope=global"
    97:   environment:
    98:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
    99:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   100:   no_log: true
   101:   changed_when: true
   102:   when:
   103:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   104:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   105:     - openbao_aws_plugin_tune is changed
   106: 
   107: # Root config holds the ONE long-lived AWS base-user key OpenBao uses to call
   108: # sts:AssumeRole. Checked via `bao read`, not the mounts list above — a mount
   109: # can exist with no root config yet configured (fresh `secrets enable`).
   110: - name: Check whether the AWS engine root config already exists
   111:   ansible.builtin.command:
   112:     cmd: "bao read -format=json {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/config/root"
   113:   environment:
   114:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
   115:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   116:   register: openbao_aws_root_check
   117:   no_log: true
   118:   changed_when: false
   119:   failed_when: false
   120:   when:
   121:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   122:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   123: 
   124: # Fail loudly rather than silently leave a mounted-but-unconfigured engine: a
   125: # skip here would make `bao read aws/sts/tf-proxmox` fail later with a much
   126: # more confusing error, and a routine converge that forgot the root key would
   127: # look green while doing nothing.
   128: - name: Refuse to leave the AWS engine mounted with no root config and no key supplied
   129:   ansible.builtin.fail:
   130:     msg: >-
   131:       The AWS secrets engine at {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/ has no root config yet,
   132:       and OPENBAO_AWS_ROOT_ACCESS_KEY_ID/OPENBAO_AWS_ROOT_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY are
   133:       unset. Seed the base-user key (minted via an independent admin path, NOT
   134:       the key being rotated out) into Doppler tier-0 and re-run with those env
   135:       vars set, or set openbao_aws_engine_enabled: false to skip AWS entirely.
   136:   when:
   137:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   138:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   139:     - (openbao_aws_root_check.rc | default(1)) != 0
   140:     - (openbao_aws_root_access_key_id | length == 0) or (openbao_aws_root_secret_access_key | length == 0)
   141: 
   142: # Write-once: a routine converge with root already configured never
   143: # overwrites/rotates it silently (mirrors the seal-key pattern) — rotation is a
   144: # deliberate, separate operator action.
   145: - name: Configure the AWS engine root credentials (first configuration only)
   146:   ansible.builtin.uri:
   147:     url: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}/v1/{{ openbao_aws_mount }}/config/root"
   148:     method: POST
   149:     headers:
   150:       X-Vault-Token: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   151:     body_format: json
   152:     body:
   153:       access_key: "{{ openbao_aws_root_access_key_id }}"
   154:       secret_key: "{{ openbao_aws_root_secret_access_key }}"
   155:       region: "{{ openbao_aws_root_region }}"
   156:     status_code:
   157:       - 200
   158:       - 204
   159:   no_log: true
   160:   changed_when: true
   161:   when:
   162:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   163:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   164:     - (openbao_aws_root_check.rc | default(1)) != 0
   165:     - openbao_aws_root_access_key_id | length > 0
   166:     - openbao_aws_root_secret_access_key | length > 0
   167: 
   168: - name: Check whether the tf-proxmox AWS role already exists
   169:   ansible.builtin.command:
   170:     cmd: "bao read -format=json {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/roles/{{ openbao_aws_role_name }}"
   171:   environment:
   172:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
   173:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   174:   register: openbao_aws_role_check
   175:   no_log: true
   176:   changed_when: false
   177:   failed_when: false
   178:   when:
   179:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   180:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   181: 
   182: - name: Create the tf-proxmox AWS role (assumed_role, add-if-missing)
   183:   ansible.builtin.command:
   184:     cmd: >-
   185:       bao write {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/roles/{{ openbao_aws_role_name }}
   186:       credential_type=assumed_role
   187:       role_arns={{ openbao_aws_role_arn }}
   188:       default_sts_ttl={{ openbao_aws_default_sts_ttl }}
   189:       max_sts_ttl={{ openbao_aws_max_sts_ttl }}
   190:   environment:
   191:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
   192:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   193:   no_log: true
   194:   changed_when: true
   195:   when:
   196:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   197:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   198:     - (openbao_aws_role_check.rc | default(1)) != 0
   199:     - openbao_aws_role_arn | length > 0
   200: 
   201: - name: Check whether the openbao-iac-admin AWS role already exists
   202:   ansible.builtin.command:
   203:     cmd: "bao read -format=json {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/roles/{{ openbao_aws_iac_admin_role_name }}"
   204:   environment:
   205:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
   206:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   207:   register: openbao_aws_iac_admin_role_check
   208:   no_log: true
   209:   changed_when: false
   210:   failed_when: false
   211:   when:
   212:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   213:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   214: 
   215: - name: Create the openbao-iac-admin AWS role (assumed_role, add-if-missing)
   216:   ansible.builtin.command:
   217:     cmd: >-
   218:       bao write {{ openbao_aws_mount }}/roles/{{ openbao_aws_iac_admin_role_name }}
   219:       credential_type=assumed_role
   220:       role_arns={{ openbao_aws_iac_admin_role_arn }}
   221:       default_sts_ttl={{ openbao_aws_iac_admin_default_sts_ttl }}
   222:       max_sts_ttl={{ openbao_aws_iac_admin_max_sts_ttl }}
   223:   environment:
   224:     BAO_ADDR: "{{ openbao_api_addr }}"
   225:     BAO_TOKEN: "{{ openbao_bootstrap_token }}"
   226:   no_log: true
   227:   changed_when: true
   228:   when:
   229:     - openbao_bootstrap_token is defined
   230:     - openbao_aws_engine_enabled | bool
   231:     - (openbao_aws_iac_admin_role_check.rc | default(1)) != 0

1: ---
     2: # Deploy RustFS S3 Storage Server
     3: #
     4: # This playbook handles:
     5: # 1. TLS certificate generation (Letsencrypt or self-signed)
     6: # 2. Fetches root credentials from HashiCorp Vault using on-demand lookups
     7: # 3. RustFS server installation and configuration using ricsanfre.rustfs role
     8: #
     9: # Note:
    10: #   S3 resources configuration (buckets, users, policies) is handled by
    11: #   configure_minio.yml — the existing Terraform module works against RustFS.
    12: #
    13: # Prerequisites:
    14: #   - Vault server deployed and running
    15: #   - S3 root secrets loaded in Vault at 'secret/minio/root'
    16: #   - Vault environment file exists:
    17: #     * ~/.secrets/vault.env
    18: #   - inventory.yml configured with [s3] group
    19: #
    20: # Usage:
    21: #   # Ensure Vault credentials file exists
    22: #   # ~/.secrets/vault.env with:
    23: #   # VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.example.com:8200
    24: #   # VAULT_TOKEN=s.xxxxxxxxxxxxx
    25: #   # VAULT_CACERT=/path/to/certificates/CA.pem
    26: #
    27: #   # Generate certificates
    28: #   ansible-playbook ansible/deploy_rustfs.yml --tags certificates
    29: #
    30: #   # Deploy RustFS server (certificates + RustFS service)
    31: #   ansible-playbook ansible/deploy_rustfs.yml
    32: 
    33: ## Generate TLS certificates for RustFS
    34: - name: Generate TLS certificates for RustFS
    35:   hosts: localhost
    36:   gather_facts: true
    37:   tags: [certificates, rustfs]
    38:   vars:
    39:     propagation_seconds: 300
    40:     selfsigned_certificates_path: "../certificates"
    41:     ionos_credentials_file: "~/.secrets/ionos-credentials.ini"
    42:     certbot_config_dir: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.certbot/config"
    43:     certbot_work_dir: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.certbot/work"
    44:     certbot_logs_dir: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.certbot/log"
    45: 
    46:   pre_tasks:
    47:     - name: Include picluster variables
    48:       ansible.builtin.include_vars: "vars/picluster.yml"
    49: 
    50:     - name: Check Ionos credentials file exists
    51:       ansible.builtin.stat:
    52:         path: "{{ ionos_credentials_file }}"
    53:       register: ionos_credentials_stat
    54:       when: enable_letsencrypt
    55: 
    56:     - name: Validate Ionos credentials file exists
    57:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    58:         that:
    59:           - ionos_credentials_stat.stat.exists
    60:           - ionos_credentials_stat.stat.isreg
    61:         fail_msg: |
    62:           ⚠️  Ionos credentials file not found!
    63: 
    64:           Please create the credentials file before running this playbook:
    65: 
    66:             {{ ionos_credentials_file }}
    67: 
    68:           Required format:
    69: 
    70:             dns_ionos_prefix = your-ionos-public-prefix
    71:             dns_ionos_secret = your-ionos-secret-key
    72: 
    73:           These credentials are used to generate Let's Encrypt certificates via Ionos DNS.
    74:       when: enable_letsencrypt
    75: 
    76:     - name: Load Ionos credentials file content
    77:       ansible.builtin.slurp:
    78:         src: "{{ ionos_credentials_file }}"
    79:       register: ionos_credentials_raw
    80:       when: enable_letsencrypt
    81: 
    82:     - name: Set Ionos credentials from file
    83:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    84:         ionos_public_prefix: "{{ (ionos_credentials_content | regex_search('(?m)^\\s*dns_ionos_prefix\\s*=\\s*(\\S+)\\s*$', '\\1') | first) | default('') }}"
    85:         ionos_secret: "{{ (ionos_credentials_content | regex_search('(?m)^\\s*dns_ionos_secret\\s*=\\s*(\\S+)\\s*$', '\\1') | first) | default('') }}"
    86:       vars:
    87:         ionos_credentials_content: "{{ ionos_credentials_raw.content | b64decode }}"
    88:       when: enable_letsencrypt
    89: 
    90:     - name: Validate Ionos credentials file format
    91:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    92:         that:
    93:           - ionos_public_prefix != ""
    94:           - ionos_secret != ""
    95:         fail_msg: |
    96:           ⚠️  Invalid Ionos credentials file format!
    97: 
    98:           File: {{ ionos_credentials_file }}
    99: 
   100:           Required format:
   101: 
   102:             dns_ionos_prefix = your-ionos-public-prefix
   103:             dns_ionos_secret = your-ionos-secret-key
   104: 
   105:           These credentials are used to generate Let's Encrypt certificates via Ionos DNS.
   106:       when: enable_letsencrypt
   107: 
   108:   tasks:
   109:     - name: Create Letsencrypt certificate for RustFS
   110:       ansible.builtin.command: |
   111:         certbot certonly \
   112:         --config-dir {{ certbot_config_dir }} \
   113:         --work-dir {{ certbot_work_dir }} \
   114:         --logs-dir {{ certbot_logs_dir }} \
   115:         --authenticator dns-ionos \
   116:         --dns-ionos-credentials {{ ionos_credentials_file }} \
   117:         --dns-ionos-propagation-seconds {{ propagation_seconds }} \
   118:         --server https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory \
   119:         --agree-tos \
   120:         --non-interactive \
   121:         --rsa-key-size 4096 \
   122:         -m {{ acme_issuer_email }} \
   123:         -d {{ rustfs_hostname }}
   124:       register: certbot_create
   125:       changed_when:
   126:         - certbot_create.rc == 0
   127:         - '"Certificate not yet due for renewal; no action taken." not in certbot_create.stdout'
   128:       when: enable_letsencrypt
   129: 
   130:     - name: Create customCA-signed TLS certificate for RustFS
   131:       when: not enable_letsencrypt
   132:       block:
   133:         # Generate self-signed certificates directory
   134:         - name: Create certificates directory
   135:           ansible.builtin.file:
   136:             path: "{{ selfsigned_certificates_path }}"
   137:             state: directory
   138:             mode: "0750"
   139: 
   140:         # Include selfsigned certificates variables
   141:         - name: Include selfsigned certificates variables
   142:           ansible.builtin.include_vars: "vars/selfsigned-certificates.yml"
   143: 
   144:         # Generate custom CA (if needed)
   145:         - name: Generate custom CA
   146:           ansible.builtin.include_tasks: tasks/generate_custom_ca.yml
   147:           args:
   148:             apply:
   149:               delegate_to: localhost
   150:               become: false
   151: 
   152:         # Generate customCA-signed TLS certificate for RustFS
   153:         - name: Generate customCA-signed SSL certificate for RustFS
   154:           ansible.builtin.include_tasks: tasks/generate_ca_signed_cert.yml
   155:           args:
   156:             apply:
   157:               delegate_to: localhost
   158:               become: false
   159:           vars:
   160:             server_hostname: "{{ rustfs_hostname }}"
   161: 
   162: # Install and Configure RustFS with Vault Integration
   163: - name: Install RustFS S3 Storage Server
   164:   hosts: s3
   165:   gather_facts: true
   166:   tags: [rustfs]
   167:   become: true
   168:   vars:
   169:     server_hostname: "{{ rustfs_hostname }}"
   170:     selfsigned_certificates_path: "../certificates"
   171:     vault_secret_file: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.secrets/vault.env"
   172:     certbot_config_dir: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.certbot/config"
   173:     certbot_work_dir: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.certbot/work"
   174:     certbot_logs_dir: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME') }}/.certbot/log"
   175: 
   176:   pre_tasks:
   177:     - name: Include picluster variables
   178:       ansible.builtin.include_vars: "vars/picluster.yml"
   179: 
   180:     - name: Check Vault secret file exists on controller
   181:       ansible.builtin.stat:
   182:         path: "{{ vault_secret_file }}"
   183:       register: vault_secret_file_stat
   184:       delegate_to: localhost
   185:       become: false
   186: 
   187:     - name: Validate Vault secret file exists
   188:       ansible.builtin.assert:
   189:         that:
   190:           - vault_secret_file_stat.stat.exists
   191:           - vault_secret_file_stat.stat.isreg
   192:         fail_msg: |
   193:           Vault secret file not found: {{ vault_secret_file }}
   194: 
   195:           Run external services stage 1 first to generate it, or create it with:
   196: 
   197:             VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.example.com:8200
   198:             VAULT_TOKEN=s.xxxxxxxxxxxxx
   199:             VAULT_CACERT=/path/to/certificates/CA.pem
   200: 
   201:     - name: Get Vault environment from secret file
   202:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
   203:         vault_addr: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.ini', 'VAULT_ADDR type=properties file=' ~ vault_secret_file) }}"
   204:         vault_token: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.ini', 'VAULT_TOKEN type=properties file=' ~ vault_secret_file) }}"
   205:         vault_cacert: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.ini', 'VAULT_CACERT type=properties file=' ~ vault_secret_file, errors='ignore') | default('', true) }}"
   206: 
   207:     - name: Validate Vault variables loaded from secret file
   208:       ansible.builtin.assert:
   209:         that:
   210:           - vault_addr is defined and vault_addr != ""
   211:           - vault_token is defined and vault_token != ""
   212:         fail_msg: |
   213:           Missing VAULT_ADDR or VAULT_TOKEN in {{ vault_secret_file }}
   214: 
   215:           Please configure Vault access before running this playbook.
   216: 
   217:     - name: Display Vault configuration (self-signed certificates)
   218:       ansible.builtin.debug:
   219:         msg: |
   220:           Vault Configuration:
   221:              VAULT_ADDR: {{ vault_addr }}
   222:              VAULT_TOKEN: {{ vault_token[:20] }}...
   223:              VAULT_CACERT: {{ vault_cacert }}
   224:       when: not enable_letsencrypt
   225: 
   226:     - name: Display Vault configuration (Let's Encrypt certificates)
   227:       ansible.builtin.debug:
   228:         msg: |
   229:           Vault Configuration:
   230:              VAULT_ADDR: {{ vault_addr }}
   231:              VAULT_TOKEN: {{ vault_token[:20] }}...
   232:       when: enable_letsencrypt
   233: 
   234:     - name: Load customCA-signed TLS certificate for RustFS
   235:       ansible.builtin.set_fact:
   236:         rustfs_tls_key: "{{ lookup('file', selfsigned_certificates_path + '/' + server_hostname + '.key') }}"
   237:         rustfs_tls_cert: "{{ lookup('file', selfsigned_certificates_path + '/' + server_hostname + '.pem') }}"
   238:       when: not enable_letsencrypt
   239: 
   240:     - name: Get letsencrypt TLS certificate for RustFS
   241:       when: enable_letsencrypt
   242:       block:
   243:         - name: Check TLS certificate for RustFS exits
   244:           ansible.builtin.command: >-
   245:             certbot certificates
   246:             --config-dir {{ certbot_config_dir }}
   247:             --work-dir {{ certbot_work_dir }}
   248:             --logs-dir {{ certbot_logs_dir }}
   249:             -d {{ rustfs_hostname }}
   250:           register: certbot_certificates
   251:           delegate_to: localhost
   252:           become: false
   253:           changed_when: false
   254:           failed_when:
   255:             - '"Certificate Name: " + rustfs_hostname not in certbot_certificates.stdout'
   256: 
   257:         - name: Get certificate and key paths for RustFS
   258:           ansible.builtin.set_fact:
   259:             cert_path: "{{ certbot_certificates.stdout | regex_search(regexp1, '\\1') }}"
   260:             cert_key_path: "{{ certbot_certificates.stdout | regex_search(regexp2, '\\1') }}"
   261:           vars:
   262:             regexp1: 'Certificate Path: (\S+)'
   263:             regexp2: 'Private Key Path: (\S+)'
   264:           when:
   265:             - certbot_certificates.rc == 0

   267:
